items.exampleEn: The road is closed, so please use the temporary bridge.
items.exampleZh: 這條路封閉了，請走臨時便橋。

items.exampleEn: She is a frequent visitor to this museum.
items.exampleZh: 她是這間博物館的常客。

items.exampleEn: The machine makes a continuous noise all day.
items.exampleZh: 這台機器整天發出持續不斷的噪音。

items.exampleEn: We have occasional rain in the dry season.
I pay my phone bill monthly.
The buses run at intervals of fifteen minutes.
items.exampleZh: 公車每隔十五分鐘一班。

items.exampleEn: He continually asks the same questions.
items.exampleZh: 他不停地問同樣的問題。

items.sentenceEn: Our team has a monthly meeting on the first Monday.
items.sentenceZh: 我們團隊在每個月的第一個星期一開月會。

items.audioEn: I'm working in a temporary office this month, but I'll move back to the main office in June.
items.audioZh: 我這個月在臨時辦公室工作，但六月會搬回總公司。

items.sentenceEn: She can listen to music and study simultaneously.
items.sentenceZh: 她可以同時聽音樂和讀書。

items.sentenceEn: There was a short interval between the two shows.
items.sentenceZh: 兩場表演之間有一段短暫的休息時間。

items.stemEn: We get ____ complaints about the noise, almost every day.
items.stemZh: 我們經常接到關於噪音的投訴，幾乎每天都有。

items.stemEn: The old printer ____ stops working; it happened five times today.
items.stemZh: 這台舊印表機一再故障，今天就壞了五次。

items.passageEn: Mia has a temporary job at a busy bookstore this summer. The store has frequent sales, so many customers come in. There is a continuous line of people waiting to pay, and the phone rings continually. Mia often has to answer the phone and help a customer simultaneously. She gets a short break at intervals of two hours. She also gets a monthly bonus if the store sells a lot. Despite the occasional bad day, she likes the job.
items.passageZh: Mia 今年夏天在一家很忙的書店做臨時工作。這家店經常有特價，所以很多客人上門。等著結帳的隊伍一直沒斷過，電話也響個不停。Mia 常常得同時接電話和招呼客人。她每隔兩個小時可以短暫休息一下。如果店裡賣得好，她每個月還能拿到獎金。儘管偶爾會有不順的一天，她還是喜歡這份工作。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼這家書店的客人很多？
Mia 多久可以休息一次？

items.promptZh: 這只是一份暫時的工作。
referenceEn: This is only a temporary job.
It is just a temporary job.
rubricZh: temporary 表示「暫時的」，可放在名詞前或 be 動詞後（例如 a temporary job、This job is only temporary）
放在單數名詞前時要有冠詞（例如 a temporary job）

items.promptZh: 除了偶爾有電話打來，今天辦公室很安靜。
referenceEn: Apart from an occasional phone call, the office was quiet today.
Except for the occasional phone call, the office was quiet today.
rubricZh: 用 occasional（形容詞）修飾名詞，表示「偶爾的」（例如 an occasional phone call、the occasional call 等）
「除了」可寫，例如 apart from、except for 等；時態配合今天的事（例如 was、has been 等）
